newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan central bank says injecting funds on Monday.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan central bank says injecting funds on Monday.

text.p: Taiwan's central bank, reacting as money rates sizzled in double digits, said it would inject funds into the banking system on Monday.

A central bank official said the bank would execute open market operations on Monday through repurchase of negotiable certificates of deposit, commercial papers, or government bonds offered by interested financial institutions.
The institutions have the option of repurchasing the NCDs, commercial papers, or government bonds within four days, the official said.
The central bank said interested financial institutions should contact the bank directly.
In a departure from previous practice, the central bank demanded that financial institutions submit reports explaining their capital flows.
Analysts said the move aimed to prevent any of the newly released liquidity from flowing into the red-hot stock market.
Bids would close at 11.00 a.m. (0300 GMT).
Funds would be released according to actual demand, the central bank said.
